text.en:
. Letter of Instruction No. 58 (series of 1973), as amended, is
hereby repealed.

The Banana Industry Export Committee is hereby dissolved.
Instead, the Department of Agriculture (DA) shall oversee the export banana
industry, as with other crops, subject to existing land use policies and plans of
the national and local governments and with due consideration to global market
demand and conditions as well as social and environmental impacts of expanding
banana plantation areas, among others.

All presidential issuances, administrative rules and
regulations, or parts thereof inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby
repealed or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately upon
publication in a national newspaper of general circulation.
Done in the City of Manila this at day of
of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Nine.
Mari Mr. Aura
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
POMA Mologram & 49134
